issues.description: Field 'Book.title' visibility mismatch: the problem statement defines a Book with a 'title' String (problem expects direct read access), and Client.main() in the solution reads book.title, but the solution's Book struct declares the title property as 'private let title: String'. Declaring the property private prevents access from Client (in a different file), causing a compilation error and blocking the intended usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the declaration of the title property in the Book struct to be accessible outside its defining type. Replace 'private let title: String' with a non-private declaration such as 'let title: String' (or explicitly 'internal let title: String' / 'public let title: String' as desired). This allows Client.main() and other files in the module to read book.title and resolves the compilation error while preserving the exercise intent.
